en: The sun is shining. It is …
When the sun shines, we say it is sunny.
Water is falling from the clouds. It is …
Rain falls from the clouds, so it is rainy.
The trees are blowing about. It is …
Wind makes the trees blow about, so it is windy.
White flakes are falling. It is …
Snow falls in white flakes, so it is snowy.
Grey clouds cover the sky. It is …
When clouds cover the sky, it is cloudy.
What do we use to stay dry in the rain?
An umbrella keeps the rain off us.
What can we build when it snows?
We can roll snow into a snowman.
What do we fly on a windy day?
The wind lifts a kite up into the sky.
What do we wear on our feet to jump in puddles?
Wellies are rubber boots that keep our feet dry.
What comes after rain when the sun shines?
Sunlight shining through raindrops makes a rainbow.
What makes a loud bang in a storm?
Thunder is the loud bang in a storm.
What is the bright flash in a storm?
Lightning is the bright flash in a storm.
When it is very cold, water turns to …
Very cold water freezes into ice.
What do we wear on a sunny day to keep the sun off our head?
A sun hat shades our head and face.
What is it called when we cannot see far because of a grey cloud near the ground?
Fog is a cloud low down near the ground.

example.why_en: When the sun shines, we say it is sunny.

en.title: Weather words
en.teach: Look out of the window and say what the weather is like: sunny, rainy, windy, snowy or cloudy.
